subject.title: [RE-OPEN REQUEST] Indexing sync failure for jjr-iot-skill (Previous #2047)

question: Should the project authorize a privileged audit and, if appropriate, repair of janeXlab’s publisher and skill visibility state for this reported package?
rationale: The evidence indicates a real public-access failure, but source-level review cannot determine whether the missing visibility is an intended security or moderation gate, an account-verification problem, or corrupt/stale production state.

options.title: Authorize a bounded production audit
options.body: Inspect the publisher, version, scan, moderation, deletion, and search-index eligibility state, then repair only the specific invalid state and record the result.

options.title: Request renewed account verification
options.body: Require the reporter to complete login/account verification before any privileged visibility-state change is considered.

options.title: Keep the package non-public
options.body: Retain the current gate if the audit confirms a valid policy, scan, moderation, or ownership restriction.

recommendation.title: Authorize a bounded production audit
recommendation.body: Inspect the publisher, version, scan, moderation, deletion, and search-index eligibility state, then repair only the specific invalid state and record the result.
